insights.headline: Gold hits seven-week low as oil surge revives Fed rate-hike bets; MCX gold slides on global cues
points: Spot gold broke below $4,200 to a seven-week low as oil-driven inflation fears boosted Fed hike bets.
MCX gold fell Rs 2,600 per 10 grams and silver Rs 5,000 a kg on Monday, tracking the global selloff.
The rupee slipped near 96 per dollar on oil woes; likely RBI dollar sales capped the fall at 95.9825.
Nomura sees an 80% chance of 25-50 bps of RBI rate hikes by December, dismissing 125 bps fears.
UBS expects silver at $70 by December and $80 by September 2027, citing gold support and tight fundamentals.
insights.summary: Gold fell to a seven-week low below $4,200 on Monday after Brent crude jumped nearly 4% to $108 on the US-Iran standoff, reviving bets on further Fed rate hikes and lifting yields and the dollar. On MCX, gold fell Rs 2,600 per 10 grams and silver plunged Rs 5,000 a kg, while Indian gold and silver ETFs slid up to 4%. The rupee weakened toward 96 per dollar despite likely RBI intervention, keeping domestic prices elevated. Analysts say this week's US jobs data will decide whether the selloff extends or stabilises.

trending.title: Rate-hike repricing rules bullion
trending.summary: Surging oil revived Fed hike bets and crushed both metals — gold hit a seven-week low globally, with MCX and Indian ETFs following. The only question: does US jobs data extend the rout?

trending.title: Rupee and rates: the domestic amplifiers
trending.summary: A near-96 rupee and a likely RBI hiking cycle are amplifying global moves for Indian buyers — the weak currency is cushioning the global fall in domestic prices.

trending.title: Silver's two stories: crash today, $80 tomorrow
trending.summary: Silver crashed harder than gold on Monday, yet UBS still sees $80 by September 2027 on gold support and tight physical supply — one day's move and a bank forecast live on different timelines.

trending.title: India's gold industry looks past the selloff
trending.summary: Beyond the day's red: a $100 billion export target for 2040, Kotak's read on falling imports, and a watchlist for the week ahead as festive demand approaches.

items.summary: Spot gold slid to a seven-week low below $4,200 on Monday as surging oil prices on the US-Iran standoff stoked inflation fears and bets on further Fed rate hikes, lifting Treasury yields and the dollar. Markets see a 70.3% chance of a Fed hike in October. Silver fell alongside ahead of US PCE and jobs data.
items.title: Gold hits 7-week low as oil-driven inflation fears boost rate-hike bets

items.summary: Gold tumbled Rs 2,600 to Rs 1.5 lakh per 10 grams in New Delhi on Monday while silver plunged Rs 5,000 to Rs 2.32 lakh per kg, tracking weak global markets as a firm dollar and Brent crude surging 4% to $108.53 on US-Iran tensions pressured precious metals.
items.title: Gold price falls Rs 2,600, silver plunges Rs 5,000 on Monday

items.summary: Indian gold and silver ETFs tumbled up to 4% on Monday, mirroring the sharp fall in bullion as Fed rate-hike bets strengthened. The slide tracked MCX futures lower, with higher US yields and a firm dollar cited as the immediate triggers.
items.title: Why Gold, silver ETFs tumbled over 4% today | What's behind the fall and what should investors do?

items.summary: The rupee slipped to an over one-week low on Monday as Brent crude jumped nearly 4% to $108.2 a barrel, with likely RBI dollar sales via state-run banks capping the fall at 95.9825 per dollar. Goldman Sachs analysts say the RBI can keep the rupee in a 94-97 range. A weaker rupee keeps domestic gold prices elevated even when global prices fall.
items.title: Oil woes push rupee to over one-week low, RBI caps fall near 96/USD

items.summary: Nomura expects the RBI to raise rates by a cumulative 25-50 basis points by December — assigning an 80% probability — ahead of the October 5-7 policy meeting, while dismissing market fears of 125 bps of hikes over the next year. It sees a terminal repo rate of 5.75%, arguing a full tightening cycle is unlikely.
items.title: Will RBI announce steep rate hikes? Nomura sees up to 50 bps increase by Dec, dismisses 125 bps hike fears

items.summary: UBS expects silver to recover to $70 an ounce by December 2026 and reach $80 by September 2027, via $75 in March and June 2027, citing support from higher gold prices and tighter near-term physical fundamentals — while cautioning that a more hawkish Fed remains a near-term headwind.
items.title: Silver Could Reach $80 by September 2027, According to UBS Forecast

items.summary: MCX and COMEX gold and silver were under pressure on Monday as rising oil, a stronger dollar and higher bond yields revived Fed rate-hike expectations. The piece walks Indian investors through the week's key triggers — US data including the jobs report, and rupee moves.
items.title: Gold, silver prices tumble up to 2.8%: What investors should watch this week

items.summary: Kotak Institutional Equities breaks down the decline in India's gold imports — softer demand at high prices, elevated import duties and a shift toward ETFs and digital gold — and what it means for domestic premiums, MCX prices and festive-season buying.
items.title: Explained - The good, bad and ugly about the decline in Gold imports by Kotak Institutional Equities

items.summary: At the 14th Delhi Jewellery & Gem Fair, industry leaders including the World Gold Council's Sachin Jain said India's gold and jewellery industry is targeting $100 billion in exports by 2040. FTA partner countries offer a $55 billion jewellery market where India currently holds just an $8 billion share.
items.title: How gold sector is gearing up $100 bn export target as India eyes massive expansion in $55 bn FTA

items.summary: Gold has slipped 6% in September after an 11% July–August rally, Moneycontrol reports, as the sharp rise in US bond yields — the 30-year near 4.7% — and renewed Fed hike bets (68% odds of a 25bp October hike per CME FedWatch) cap near-term upside, while central-bank buying provides structural support.
items.title: Gold's next leg higher faces hurdle as yields rise, Fed rate-hike bets return

items.summary: An explainer on what the Fed's rate-hike path means for gold, the rupee and Indian markets — higher US yields raise the opportunity cost of holding gold and tend to lift the dollar, pressuring both global bullion and domestic prices.
items.title: What Fed's rate hike means for gold, the rupee and Indian markets

items.summary: Technical analysts see $4,000 an ounce as the next key level for gold as bears press their advantage amid intensifying Fed rate-hike bets, with a break below risking a deeper correction in bullion.
items.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD remains vulnerable as sellers target $4,000

items.summary: In its Questor weekly outlook, the Telegraph's Russ Mould argues silver looks poised to follow in gold's footsteps — holding steady around $60 after retreating from $117 highs and forming a base.
items.title: Why silver could shine again

items.summary: Australia's Northern Star rejected a $27 billion takeover bid from South Africa's Gold Fields that would have created the world's second-largest gold miner, saying the offer undervalued the company.
items.title: Northern Star rejects Gold Fields' $27 billion bid to create world's No.2 gold miner
